Snapped camera coordinate is re-admitted as ScenePlanPoint before use.

Relief, drainage, strata, roots and road arithmetic are cfg(test) owners with fixed positive wavelength/width denominators and bounded fixture loops; these are not runtime authority. Arbitrary raw helper radii/coordinates can violate native assumptions, but actual calls here use positive1.5 spacing and fixed normal terrain. Production arithmetic obligations live in tactical-core authoritative terrain, not discharged by these formula fixtures. Source fixture assertions are evidence of intended bounds/transition collars, not passing tests.
